title: How to insulate an attic the right way

lines.show: You want a {g:warm} house in winter.
But up to a {r:quarter} of your heat
escapes through the roof.
So you lay {y:insulation} between the beams,
at least {y:20 centimeters} thick.
But the wooden beams still {r:leak} heat.
So you add a second layer {y:crosswise} on top.
Then moist air from inside
creeps into the insulation and makes it {r:wet}.
So you add a {y:vapor barrier}
on the warm side, underneath.
But you stuffed the {r:vents} at the edges.
So you keep an {y:air gap}
under the roof, so it can breathe.
Then you store boxes on it and {r:squash} it flat.
So you build a {y:raised} walkway above it.
Last, the attic {r:hatch} lets heat out.
So you insulate and {y:seal} it too.
{y:Congratulations}.
You built an attic
that keeps the heat {g:inside}.
